prepare.command:
docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -v '/Users/wsx/Documents/GitHub/oxo-flow/.claude/worktrees/agent-a4811d73744c25b76/docs/superpowers/audits/data/crossarch-1397/arm-local-arm64/work/cross-arch-provenance-governed-a':'/Users/wsx/Documents/GitHub/oxo-flow/.claude/worktrees/agent-a4811d73744c25b76/docs/superpowers/audits/data/crossarch-1397/arm-local-arm64/work/cross-arch-provenance-governed-a' -w '/Users/wsx/Documents/GitHub/oxo-flow/.claude/worktrees/agent-a4811d73744c25b76/docs/superpowers/audits/data/crossarch-1397/arm-local-arm64/work/cross-arch-provenance-governed-a' 'crossarch1397:pin' sh -c 'if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -c "$1"; else exec sh -c "$1"; fi' sh 'mkdir -p '\''data'\'' '\''control'\''
set -eu
export LC_ALL=C
mkdir -p data control
: > data/payload.txt
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 64 ]; do
  echo "line $i value $((i * 37 % 97))" >> data/payload.txt
  i=$((i + 1))
done
python3 -c "
import sys
for i in range(1, 27):
    sys.stdout.write('\''letter %02d %s'\'' % (i, chr(96 + i)) + chr(10))
" > data/alphabet.txt
python3 -c "
import sys
lines = [
    '\''frozen governed cross-architecture corpus'\'',
    '\''deterministic bytes only'\'',
    '\''no timestamps'\'',
    '\''no urandom'\'',
    '\''native x86_64 versus native aarch64'\'',
]
sys.stdout.write(chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10))
" > data/notes.txt
python3 -c "
import sys
sys.stdout.buffer.write(bytes((i * 53 + 7) % 256 for i in range(4096)))
" > data/bytes.bin
python3 -c "
import sys
sys.stdout.buffer.write(bytes((i * 131 + 17) % 256 for i in range(8192)))
" > data/pattern.bin
python3 -c "
import sys
x = 0x12345678
out = bytearray()
for i in range(2048):
    x = (1103515245 * x + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
    out.append((x >> 16) & 0xff)
sys.stdout.buffer.write(bytes(out))
" > data/mask.bin
uname -m > control/os_arch.txt
'
